Build with us
Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.
Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.
With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.
We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.
Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

You'll be the engine of our sales team — the first voice new businesses hear when they discover Mollie. That's not a small thing. Every inbound lead is a real company looking for a better way to manage payments, and you'll be the one who helps them find it. You'll move fast, think on your feet, and make sure no opportunity slips through the cracks.
This role is built for someone who wants to learn sales properly, from the ground up. You won't just be passing leads along — you'll own the full sales cycle for smaller businesses, closing deals yourself and building the skills that will define your career. Alongside that, you'll sharpen your instincts through outbound prospecting, giving you a complete picture of how great commercial teams operate.
If you're ambitious, curious, and ready to grow fast in a company that's scaling across Europe, this is where you start.
What you'll ship
Manage inbound lead flow with speed and professionalism, ensuring every business that reaches out gets a sharp, timely first response
Qualify leads effectively by understanding each business's needs, challenges and goals — and matching them to the right Mollie solution
Own the full sales cycle for smaller businesses, taking deals from first contact through to close
Route high-potential leads to the right Account Executives with clean, well-documented handovers that set the next stage up for success
Build pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting, complementing inbound work with proactive engagement
Keep CRM records accurate and up to date, and feed insights back to Sales and Marketing to help sharpen our acquisition strategy

Fluency in German and English — you're confident communicating clearly and professionally in both, written and spoken
Exceptional communication skills — you know how to listen, ask the right questions, and get your point across without overcomplicating it
Genuine curiosity about business, e-commerce and technology — you like understanding how things work and you're drawn to solving problems
Ambition and a coachable mindset — you're hungry to grow, open to feedback, and motivated to keep improving
Resilience and a positive attitude — you don't get thrown off easily, and you bring energy to the work even when things don't go to plan

Grow your way
At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.
You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.
No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.
Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy.
If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.
Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

Du suchst aktiv Feedback, bringst neue Ideen ein und wächst in einem Umfeld, das sich ständig weiterentwickelt.
Du hältst, was du versprichst, handelst ehrlich und trägst zu einer Kultur bei, in der direktes, konstruktives Feedback selbstverständlich ist.
Du arbeitest täglich mit KI-Tools wie Claude für Recherche, Outreach, Discovery-Vorbereitung und Account-Analyse.

About The Position: We are seeking a highly motivated, resilient, and results-driven Outbound Business Development Representative to join our fast-growing company. In this role, you won't be waiting for leads to come to you—you will be the engine driving our front-line growth.

As an Outbound BDR, you will focus strictly on net-new business acquisition, identifying high-value targets, mapping out key decision-makers, and executing rigorous cold outreach strategies.

The ideal candidate is a true hunter with a passion for the thrill of the chase, excellent objection-handling skills, and a strategic mindset for penetrating cold accounts. This is an exciting opportunity to be a critical pipeline driver in a high-growth SaaS environment. What You Will Do:

Drive Outbound Pipeline: Proactively prospect, map, and penetrate target accounts using a mix of multi-channel outreach, including high-volume cold calling, personalized email sequences, LinkedIn video/voice notes, and other creative social selling tactics.

Execute Strategic Account Mapping: Research enterprise and mid-market organizations to identify key decision-makers (C-level, HR Leaders, CFOs) and uncover hidden pain points related to global expansion.

Own the First Touch: Conduct high-impact discovery conversations with cold prospects, effectively educating them on G-P’s Employer of Record (EOR) value proposition, overcoming initial friction, and booking qualified meetings for the Account Executive team.

Manage Objections: Confidently navigate gatekeepers and handle complex objections regarding global payroll, compliance, and competing solutions.

Data-Driven Prospecting: Maintain meticulous records of your outreach sequences, account maps, and conversion metrics within our CRM (Salesforce) and sales engagement tools (e.g., Outreach/Salesloft).

Market Intelligence: Stay ahead of macroeconomic trends, geopolitical shifts, and competitor movements to sharply position G-P as the definitive global employment solution.

Hit the Numbers: Consistently meet or exceed monthly quotas for cold outreach activity, qualified opportunities generated, and pipeline contribution.

The Hunter Mindset: Proven track record in a pure outbound sales development, lead generation, or cold-calling heavy role (SaaS experience highly preferred).

Resilience & Grit: High emotional intelligence with the ability to handle rejection professionally, pivot strategies quickly, and maintain high energy throughout the day.

Prospecting Skills: Will to learn and use tools (e.g. Cognism, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach, Salesforce,).

Elite Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to write highly personalized, compelling cold copy that cuts through the noise.

Strategic Thinking: Ability to understand complex business models and articulate how a global EOR platform solves specific corporate expansion pain points.

Self-Starter: Highly organized, disciplined, and capable of managing a high volume of outbound activity independently in a remote-first environment.

Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with the Employer of Record industry, HR outsourcing, global payroll, or workforce management is a massive plus but not essential

Education: Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field is preferred but not essential

**Le poste - en résumé**
Ce poste est un rôle classique de chasseur. Votre première tâche n'est pas de gérer un portefeuille clients existant, mais d'en construire un. Vous identifiez les entreprises industrielles de votre région qui ne collaborent pas encore avec CRIDEC, ouvrez des portes, construisez un pipeline de nouveaux clients - et le maintenez systématiquement actif.

*Conquérir - le cœur du poste*
* Identifier et acquérir activement les entreprises industrielles de la région Mittelland qui ne sont pas encore clientes.
* Fixer des rendez-vous qualifiés, identifier les besoins en matière d'élimination des déchets spéciaux et développer des solutions adaptées.

*Suivre - avec une discipline inflexible*
* Entretenir activement chaque contact : chez nous, un lead sans suivi est un lead perdu - et nous ne perdons aucun lead.
* Maintenir le CRM en temps réel : chaque visite, chaque action de relance, chaque opportunité est enregistrée.

*Représenter*
* Être le visage de CRIDEC dans le Mittelland : événements sectoriels, partenaires, associations.
* Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe commerciale et s'appuyer sur nos deux sites d'Eclépens et Winterthour.
**Ce qui nous motive**
Chez CRIDEC, la protection est primordiale : c'est le véritable sens de notre travail. Nous préférons agir de manière proactive plutôt que de subir les évolutions, tenir nos promesses même lorsque c'est difficile, et avancer ensemble dans le respect mutuel. Dans ce poste, ces valeurs prennent une signification concrète : chaque promesse faite à un prospect est tenue, chaque action de relance annoncée est réalisée, et chaque client gagné est bien accompagné.
**Ce poste vous correspond si**
* La conquête de nouveaux clients est votre terrain de jeu : vous avez une expérience avérée et démontrable en acquisition B2B - et c'est ce que vous aimez dans ce métier.

* Vous connaissez la région Mittelland (Berne, Soleure) et êtes prêt(e) à passer la majeure partie de votre temps sur le terrain.

Des connaissances dans le secteur des déchets, la chimie ou le domaine environnemental réglementé sont un avantage clair - nous vous formons cependant dans le domaine technique. Le talent pour l'acquisition et la persévérance ne s'apprennent pas.

**Ce que nous vous offrons**
* Un marché à conquérir : la Suisse alémanique est une priorité stratégique, et vous en êtes la force motrice.
* Un haut degré d'autonomie ainsi qu'une influence directe, visible et mesurable sur les résultats de l'entreprise.
* Une mission porteuse de sens dans un secteur central pour la transition écologique.
* Une entreprise à taille humaine, majoritairement publique, en forte croissance, où vos idées comptent.
* Une voiture de fonction.
* La possibilité de télétravail partiel.
* Le soutien de nos deux sites d'Eclépens et Winterthour ainsi que d'équipes fières de leur travail.
* Un salaire correspondant à votre expérience sur la base de 13 mois, ainsi que des prestations sociales attractives.
